tool_args.rationale: Three stationary-model attempts have failed fresh confirmation, including a flexible history/state extension. The remaining concrete uncertainty is between stationary mechanisms, and the extra trajectory batch is the only available unspent probe that can add informative observations; abstention is not justified by the available evidence.

considered_alternatives.option: sink-modulated siphon with an open-sign branch term
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Its fresh confirmation RMSE was 0.063034, above the 0.045 tolerance.

considered_alternatives.option: sink-pool model extended with state and history terms
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Its fresh confirmation RMSE was 0.096733, so this flexible extension did not generalize.
The evidence shows model mismatch, but no high-frequency chaotic oscillation or other direct indication of non-stationarity.
It is explicitly irrelevant to resolving the mechanism ambiguity.
